scanNote:
WORKBOOK 38-BET. Unit 9 — had/could, yo'l ko'rsatish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 7a (5 gap), 7b (5 savol-javob), 8-mashq (5 tanlov), 9-mashq (10 tuzatish), 10-mashq (xaritadan 5 ko'rsatma + 3 dialog) — jami 28 ta javob.

⚠ 10-MAShQ XARITADAN TEKShIRILDI:
  1-dialog: dorixona (Elizabeth ko'chasining yuqorisida) → pochta (o'sha ko'chaning pastida): 'go straight DOWN Elizabeth Street. The post office is ON YOUR LEFT.'
  2-dialog: park (o'ng yuqorida) → gazeta do'koni (pastda, o'rtada): 'go straight DOWN King Street and take the FIRST TURNING into Bridge Street. The newsagent's is ON YOUR RIGHT.'
  ⚠ 'DOWN the street' = ko'cha bo'ylab yurish (pastga tushish emas). O'zbekchada 'bo'ylab' deb tarjima qilinadi.
  ⚠ 'take the first turning' = birinchi burilishga kirish.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — O'N XATO, TO'RT TURI:
  zamon vaqt so'ziga mos emas: 'can ... when he was six' → COULD; 'We ARE at the park YESTERDAY' → WERE; 'I HAVE a lot of toys when I was ten' → HAD; 'Anne WAS at school AT THE MOMENT' → IS; 'There ISN'T an airport here THEN' → WASN'T; 'Rosie COULD swim NOW' → CAN
  'didn't' dan keyin asosiy shakl: 'didn't HAD' → didn't HAVE; 'Did he HAS' → Did he HAVE
  ega-fe'l mosligi: 'Washington and Lincoln WAS' → WERE (ikki odam)
  ⚠ Vashington va Linkoln haqiqatan AQSh prezidentlari bo'lgan — fakt to'g'ri, faqat fe'l xato.

⚠ 7a — 'DIDN'T HAVE' QOLIPI: bugungi narsa o'n besh yil oldin YO'Q edi. Har gapda avval inkor, keyin o'sha paytdagi haqiqiy narsa aytiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the prompts and make sentences about Amy, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarga qarang va Emi haqida namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI RO'YXAT:

  AMY, FIFTEEN YEARS AGO     AMY, TODAY
  (10 years old)             (25 years old)

  long hair                  short hair
  pet cat                    pet dog
  bicycle                    car
  a lot of toys              a computer
  a record player            a CD player

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Amy DIDN'T HAVE short hair fifteen years ago.
  She HAD long hair.

QOLIP — DIQQAT, TARTIB TESKARI:
  Amy DIDN'T HAVE [BUGUNGI narsa] fifteen years ago.
  She HAD [O'SHANDAGI narsa].

  Ya'ni AVVAL bugungi narsani INKOR qilamiz,
  SO'NG o'shandagi narsani TASDIQLAYMIZ.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  didn't HAVE   ✓   (had EMAS!)
  She HAD       ✓   ('did' yo'q → had)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a record player = plastinka pleyeri (eski)
  a CD player     = disk pleyeri (yangi)
  a pet           = uy hayvoni

items.textEn: short hair (bugun)  /  long hair (15 yil oldin)
items.answer: Amy didn't have short hair fifteen years ago. She had long hair.
items.whyUz:
Avval bugungi narsa INKOR qilinadi ('didn't have short hair'),
so'ng o'shandagisi TASDIQLANADI ('had long hair').
'didn't HAVE' — 'had' EMAS.

items.textEn: a pet dog (bugun)  /  a pet cat (15 yil oldin)
items.answer: Amy didn't have a pet dog fifteen years ago. She had a pet cat.
items.whyUz:
'a pet dog' — bugungi, shuning uchun INKOR.
'a pet cat' — o'shandagi, shuning uchun TASDIQ.
'a pet' = uy hayvoni.

items.textEn: a car (bugun)  /  a bicycle (15 yil oldin)
items.answer: Amy didn't have a car fifteen years ago. She had a bicycle.
items.whyUz:
10 yoshli bolada mashina bo'lmaydi — velosiped bo'ladi.
'a bicycle' = velosiped.

items.textEn: a computer (bugun)  /  a lot of toys (15 yil oldin)
items.answer: Amy didn't have a computer fifteen years ago. She had a lot of toys.
items.whyUz:
'a lot of toys' — ko'plik, artikl kerak emas.
'a computer' — birlik, 'a' bilan.

items.textEn: a CD player (bugun)  /  a record player (15 yil oldin)
items.answer: Amy didn't have a CD player fifteen years ago. She had a record player.
items.hintUz: Bugun disk pleyer, o'shanda plastinka pleyeri
items.whyUz:
'a record player' = plastinka pleyeri — eski texnika.
'a CD player' = kompakt disk pleyeri — yangiroq.
Texnika o'zgarishi — butun 9-unitning mavzusi.

exercises.instructionEn: Now, in pairs, ask and answer questions about Amy, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi juftlikda Emi haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did Amy have short hair when she was ten years old?
  SB: No, she didn't. She had long hair.

QOLIP:
  SA: DID Amy HAVE [bugungi narsa] when she WAS ten years old?
  SB: No, she DIDN'T. She HAD [o'shandagi narsa].

DIQQAT — 7a DAN FARQI:
  7a da 'fifteen years ago' edi,
  7b da 'when she was ten years old' — ma'no bir xil
  (15 yil oldin u 10 yoshda edi).

UCH QOIDA:
  1) So'roqda 'HAVE' (had EMAS)
  2) Qisqa javobda 'DIDN'T' (hadn't EMAS)
  3) Tasdiqda 'HAD' ('did' yo'q)

items.question: Did Amy have short hair when she was ten years old?
items.answer: No, she didn't. She had long hair.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
So'roqda HAVE, qisqa javobda DIDN'T, tasdiqda HAD.

items.prompt: a pet dog / a pet cat
items.question: Did Amy have a pet dog when she was ten years old?
items.answer: No, she didn't. She had a pet cat.
items.whyUz: Bugungi narsa haqida so'raladi, o'shandagi bilan javob beriladi.

items.question: Did Amy have a car when she was ten years old?
items.answer: No, she didn't. She had a bicycle.
items.whyUz: 10 yoshda mashina emas, velosiped bor edi.

items.prompt: a computer / a lot of toys
items.question: Did Amy have a computer when she was ten years old?
items.answer: No, she didn't. She had a lot of toys.
items.whyUz: 'a lot of toys' — ko'plik, artiklsiz.

items.prompt: a CD player / a record player
items.question: Did Amy have a CD player when she was ten years old?
items.answer: No, she didn't. She had a record player.
items.whyUz: Eski texnika ↔ yangi texnika.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR GAPDA VAQT BELGISINI TOPING:

  O'TGAN:  last night, when I was ...
  HOZIRGI: vaqt belgisi yo'q, yoki 'now',
           yoki keyingi gap hozirgi zamonda

DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA KEYINGI GAPGA QARANG:
  'He WORKS in a hospital' — hozirgi zamon,
  demak birinchi gap ham hozirgi zamonda.

items.textEn: 1  There are / were twenty people at the party last night.
items.whyUz:
'last night' = kecha kechqurun → O'TGAN zamon.
'twenty people' KO'PLIK → WERE.

items.textEn: 2  Can / Could you speak French?
items.whyUz:
Gapda O'TGAN zamon belgisi YO'Q →
HOZIRGI qobiliyat so'ralmoqda → CAN.
'speak French' = fransuzcha gapirmoq (til oldidan artikl yo'q).

items.textEn: 3  Sam has got / got blue eyes and thin lips.
items.whyUz:
Ko'z rangi — DOIMIY belgi → HOZIRGI zamon.
'Sam' 3-shaxs birlik → HAS GOT.
DIQQAT: 'got' yolg'iz ishlatilmaydi.
'thin lips' = ingichka lablar.

items.textEn: 4  I can't / couldn't walk when I was one year old.
items.whyUz:
'when I was one year old' → O'TGAN zamon → COULDN'T.
Bir yoshli bola hali yura olmaydi — mantiq ham to'g'ri keladi.

items.textEn: 5  My father is / was a doctor. He works in a hospital.
items.whyUz:
Keyingi gap 'He WORKS in a hospital' — HOZIRGI zamon.
Demak otasi HOZIR ham shifokor → IS.
Agar 'was' bo'lsa, keyingi gap 'He worked' bo'lardi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Tim CAN'T cook when he was six.  →  COULDN'T

Har bir gapda BITTA xato bor.

UCH XIL XATO:

  1) ZAMON MOS EMAS
     Gap ichida o'tgan zamon belgisi bor, lekin fe'l
     hozirgi zamonda (yoki teskarisi).

  2) 'DID/DIDN'T' DAN KEYIN NOTO'G'RI SHAKL
     didn't HAD → didn't HAVE
     Did he HAS → Did he HAVE

  3) EGA BILAN MOS EMAS
     Washington and Lincoln WAS → WERE

USUL: avval gapdagi VAQT so'zini toping
(when he was six, a hundred years ago, yesterday,
when I was ten, at the moment, then, now),
so'ng fe'l unga mos keladimi — tekshiring.

items.textEn: 1  Tim can't cook when he was six.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'when he WAS six' → o'tgan zamon.
'can't' emas, COULDN'T.
To'g'ri gap: Tim COULDN'T cook when he was six.

items.textEn: 2  They didn't had computers a hundred years ago.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'didn't' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan →
keyingi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda → HAVE.
To'g'ri gap: They didn't HAVE computers a hundred years ago.

items.textEn: 3  We are at the park yesterday.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'yesterday' → O'TGAN zamon.
'We' KO'PLIK → WERE.
To'g'ri gap: We WERE at the park yesterday.

items.textEn: 4  I have a lot of toys when I was ten.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'when I was ten' → O'TGAN zamon.
'did' YO'Q → fe'lning o'zi o'tgan shaklda: HAD.
To'g'ri gap: I HAD a lot of toys when I was ten.

items.textEn: 5  He can paint when he was four.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'when he was four' → O'TGAN zamon → COULD.
To'g'ri gap: He COULD paint when he was four.

items.textEn: 6  Anne was at school at the moment.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' = ayni damda → HOZIRGI zamon.
'Anne' BIRLIK → IS.
To'g'ri gap: Anne IS at school at the moment.

items.textEn: 7  There isn't an airport here then.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'then' = o'shanda → O'TGAN zamon.
'an airport' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
To'g'ri gap: There WASN'T an airport here then.

items.textEn: 8  Rosie could swim very well now.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon → CAN.
To'g'ri gap: Rosie CAN swim very well now.

items.textEn: 9  Washington and Lincoln was Presidents of the USA.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'Washington AND Lincoln' — IKKI odam, KO'PLIK → WERE.
'Presidents' ham ko'plikda — bu ham ko'plikni tasdiqlaydi.
To'g'ri gap: Washington and Lincoln WERE Presidents of the USA.

items.textEn: 10  Did he has a computer then?  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'Did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda → HAVE.
'has' — 3-shaxs birlik shakli, 'did' bilan ishlatilmaydi.
To'g'ri gap: Did he HAVE a computer then?

exercises.explanationUz:
XARITA TUZILISHI:

     │Elizabeth                    │King
     │Street                       │Street
  ───┼──────────────┬──────────────┼────────────
     │ CHEMIST'S    │ LIBRARY      │ PARK
     │              │              │
     │ CAFÉ         │              │
     ├──────────────┼──────────────┤
     │ POST OFFICE  │ HOTEL        │ HOSPITAL
     │ NEWSAGENT'S  │              │
  ═══╪════════ BRIDGE STREET ══════╪════════════
     │ SUPERMARKET │ GREENGROCER'S │ CINEMA │ BAKER'S

UCH KO'CHA:
  ELIZABETH STREET — tik, chapda
  KING STREET      — tik, o'ngda
  BRIDGE STREET    — yotiq, pastda

CHAP-O'NGNI ANIQLASH — ENG MUHIM QISM:

  Chap va o'ng YURISH YO'NALISHIGA bog'liq!

  Tik ko'chada PASTGA (janubga) yursangiz:
     sharq → CHAPDA,  g'arb → O'NGDA

  Bridge Street bo'ylab SHARQQA yursangiz:
     janub → O'NGDA,  shimol → CHAPDA

  Bridge Street bo'ylab G'ARBGA yursangiz:
     janub → CHAPDA,  shimol → O'NGDA

FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  Excuse me, is there a ... near here?
     = Kechirasiz, bu yaqinda ... bormi?
  go straight down ... Street
     = ... ko'cha bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring
  take the first turning into ... Street
     = birinchi burilishdan ... ko'chaga kiring
  It's on your left / right.
     = U chap / o'ng tomoningizda.

points.en: Elizabeth Street, King Street, Bridge Street
points.noteUz: Elizabeth va King — TIK;  Bridge — YOTIQ.

points.en: first turning, on your left, down, on your right
points.noteUz: 'down' IKKI marta ishlatiladi (5 ta bo'shliq bor).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the map below and fill in the dialogues with first turning, on your left, down, on your right.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xaritaga qarang va dialoglarni first turning, on your left, down, on your right bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  1-DIALOG (A dorixonada, pochtaga bormoqchi):
    A: Excuse me, is there a post office near here?
    B: Yes, go straight DOWN Elizabeth Street.
       The post office is ON YOUR LEFT.

  2-DIALOG (A bog'da, gazeta do'koniga bormoqchi):
    A: Excuse me, is there a newsagent's near here?
    B: Yes, go straight DOWN King Street and take the
       FIRST TURNING into Bridge Street.
       The newsagent's is ON YOUR RIGHT.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  1-dialog:
    A: Kechirasiz, bu yaqinda pochta bormi?
    B: Ha, Elizabeth Street bo'ylab to'g'ri pastga yuring.
       Pochta chap tomoningizda.
  2-dialog:
    A: Kechirasiz, bu yaqinda gazeta do'koni bormi?
    B: Ha, King Street bo'ylab to'g'ri pastga yuring va
       birinchi burilishdan Bridge Street ga kiring.
       Gazeta do'koni o'ng tomoningizda.

DIQQAT — 'DOWN' IKKI MARTA:
  To'rtta ibora berilgan, beshta bo'shliq bor —
  demak bittasi ikki marta ishlatiladi.
  'down' — tik ko'chada pastga yurish uchun, ikkalasida ham.

lines.textEn: (A dorixonada, pochtaga bormoqchi)  Excuse me, is there a post office near here?

lines.whyUz:
'go straight DOWN ... Street' = ... ko'cha bo'ylab pastga yurish.
Dorixona yuqorida, pochta pastda — demak PASTGA yuriladi.

lines.hintUz: Elizabeth Street bo'ylab pastga yurganda binolar qaysi tomonda?
lines.whyUz:
Binolar (dorixona, kafe, pochta, gazeta do'koni)
Elizabeth Street ning SHARQIDA.
Janubga yurganda sharq CHAP tomonda qoladi → ON YOUR LEFT.

lines.textEn: (A bog'da, gazeta do'koniga bormoqchi)  Excuse me, is there a newsagent's near here?

lines.whyUz:
Bog' King Street ning yuqori qismida.
Bridge Street pastda — demak DOWN King Street.

lines.textEn: ... and take the 4) ............ into Bridge Street.
lines.whyUz:
'take the FIRST TURNING into ... Street' =
birinchi burilishdan ... ko'chaga kiring.
King Street dan pastga yurganda Bridge Street —
birinchi kesishma.

lines.hintUz: Bridge Street bo'ylab g'arbga yurganda gazeta do'koni qaysi tomonda?
lines.whyUz:
Bridge Street ga burilib G'ARBGA yurasiz.
Gazeta do'koni Bridge Street ning SHIMOLIDA.
G'arbga yurganda shimol O'NG tomonda qoladi → ON YOUR RIGHT.

exercises.instructionEn: Now use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi quyidagi holatlar bo'yicha shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  A: Excuse me, is there a [joy] near here?
  B: Yes, go straight down [ko'cha] (and take the first
     turning into [ko'cha]). The [joy] is on your
     left/right.

CHAP-O'NGNI ANIQLASH:

  Bridge Street bo'ylab SHARQQA (o'ngga) yursangiz:
     pastdagi do'konlar → O'NGDA

  Bridge Street bo'ylab G'ARBGA (chapga) yursangiz:
     pastdagi do'konlar → CHAPDA

BRIDGE STREET OSTIDAGI QATOR (chapdan o'ngga):
  SUPERMARKET | GREENGROCER'S | CINEMA | BAKER'S

items.prompt: You are at the supermarket and you want to go to the baker's.
items.question: Excuse me, is there a baker's near here?
items.answer: Yes, go straight down Bridge Street. The baker's is on your right.
items.whyUz:
Supermarket ham, nonvoyxona ham Bridge Street OSTIDA.
Supermarket eng chapda, nonvoyxona eng o'ngda →
SHARQQA yurasiz.
Sharqqa yurganda janub (do'konlar tomoni) O'NGDA → on your right.

items.prompt: You are at the hospital and you want to go to the greengrocer's.
items.question: Excuse me, is there a greengrocer's near here?
items.answer: Yes, go straight down King Street and take the first turning into Bridge Street. The greengrocer's is on your left.
items.whyUz:
Kasalxona King Street ning sharqida.
King Street bo'ylab pastga → Bridge Street ga burilib G'ARBGA.
G'arbga yurganda janub (do'konlar tomoni) CHAPDA → on your left.

items.prompt: You are at the café and you want to go to the cinema.
items.question: Excuse me, is there a cinema near here?
items.answer: Yes, go straight down Elizabeth Street and take the first turning into Bridge Street. The cinema is on your right.
items.whyUz:
Kafe Elizabeth Street yonida, yuqorida.
Elizabeth Street bo'ylab pastga → Bridge Street ga burilib SHARQQA.
Sharqqa yurganda janub (do'konlar tomoni) O'NGDA → on your right.
2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda g'arbga yurilgani uchun CHAPDA edi.

wordFormation.introUz: 38-bet — had/didn't have, xatolarni topish, yo'l ko'rsatish.

groups.ruleUz: HAD, DIDN'T HAVE, DID ... HAVE — uchtasi birga

items.base: take the first turning into ... Street

groups.ruleUz: Zamon belgilari — xato topish uchun kalit
groups.explanationUz: 9-mashqda har bir gapda shu so'zlardan biri bor.

patterns.formula: X DIDN'T HAVE [bugungi narsa] ... years ago. She HAD [o'shandagi narsa].
patterns.exampleEn: Amy didn't have short hair fifteen years ago. She had long hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Emining o'n besh yil oldin kalta sochi yo'q edi. Uzun sochi bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz: Avval bugungi narsa inkor qilinadi, so'ng o'shandagisi tasdiqlanadi.

patterns.formula: DID + ega + HAVE + ot + when she WAS ... years old?  →  No, she DIDN'T. She HAD ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Did Amy have short hair when she was ten years old? — No, she didn't. She had long hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Emi o'n yoshida kalta sochli midi? — Yo'q. Uzun sochi bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz: So'roqda HAVE, qisqa javobda DIDN'T, tasdiqda HAD.

patterns.formula: Excuse me, is there a + joy + NEAR HERE?
patterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, is there a post office near here?
patterns.explanationUz: Notanish odamdan joy so'rashning eng oddiy shakli.

patterns.formula: Go straight DOWN ... Street (and TAKE THE FIRST TURNING INTO ... Street). It's ON YOUR left/right.
patterns.exampleEn: Yes, go straight down King Street and take the first turning into Bridge Street. The newsagent's is on your right.
patterns.exampleUz: Ha, King Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring va birinchi burilishdan Bridge Street ga kiring. Gazeta do'koni o'ng tomoningizda.
patterns.explanationUz: Chap-o'ng YURISH YO'NALISHIGA bog'liq — xaritaga qarab aniqlang.

patterns.formula: Ega + IS + kasb.  +  He/She WORKS in ... .
patterns.exampleEn: My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala gap ham HOZIRGI zamonda bo'lishi kerak —
zamon mosligini keyingi gapdan tekshiring.
